other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Imputation and categorical encoding are fitted on an initial training subset (85% of the data), but the data is subsequently recombined to perform 5-fold cross-validation. This leaks the preprocessing statistics into the CV validation folds, making the CV scores overly optimistic.

summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with appropriate date-based feature engineering and a robust cross-validation setup. However, it introduces moderate leakage into the cross-validation loop by computing imputation statistics on an initial split and then recombining the data for CV. Furthermore, it wastes compute by training a final model that is never actually used for inference.
